skill.name: deployment-engineer
skill.description: Deployment engineering guidance for CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, progressive delivery, container security, and release automation.
skill.summary: Plan and improve secure CI/CD, GitOps, and progressive delivery workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The referenced line advises approval gates and rollback plans for production deployments, which is a safety control rather than system reconnaissance.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid production rollouts without approvals and rollback plans.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 36 tells users to avoid production rollouts without approvals and rollback plans. This is defensive release guidance, not host discovery, system probing, or reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Deployment work can fail when releases lack gates, rollback paths, or environment controls. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan safer CI/CD, GitOps, and progressive delivery workflows.
actual_capabilities: Designs CI/CD pipeline stages with quality gates, approvals, and rollback planning.
Plans GitOps workflows using tools such as ArgoCD, Flux, Helm, and Kustomize.
Recommends progressive delivery patterns including rolling, blue-green, canary, and automated rollback strategies.
Integrates security controls such as secret validation, vulnerability scanning, image signing, and policy enforcement.
Defines observability, alerting, and runbook requirements for deployment health and incident response.
limitations: Does not execute deployments or modify infrastructure by itself.
Requires accurate details about environments, approval rules, and existing delivery tools.
Cannot replace organization-specific compliance review for regulated production systems.
Needs human validation before applying generated pipeline or GitOps changes.

use_cases.title: Create a safer release path
use_cases.description: Plan CI/CD stages, checks, approvals, and rollback steps for a production application.

use_cases.title: Adopt GitOps for Kubernetes
use_cases.description: Map repositories, environment promotion, configuration overlays, and sync policies for Kubernetes delivery.

use_cases.title: Add deployment security controls
use_cases.description: Identify where to add secret handling, image scanning, signing, policy checks, and compliance evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review my deployment process
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment of an existing release workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current deployment process for [application]. Environments are [environments], tools are [tools], and the main failure risks are [risks]. Recommend safer stages, approvals, rollback steps, and monitoring checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a CI/CD pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate pipeline design for one service or application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI/CD pipeline for [application type] using [platform]. Include build, test, security scanning, artifact handling, deployment gates, environment promotion, and rollback planning.

prompt_templates.title: Plan GitOps delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a GitOps workflow for [Kubernetes application] using [ArgoCD or Flux]. Cover repository structure, Helm or Kustomize strategy, secret management, promotion rules, sync policy, drift detection, and rollback procedures.

prompt_templates.title: Build enterprise release controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an enterprise deployment standard for [organization context]. Include reusable pipeline templates, compliance gates, SLSA or SBOM controls, progressive delivery, observability requirements, incident response, and developer self-service guardrails.

output_examples.input: Design a secure deployment pipeline for a containerized web service.
output_examples.output: A staged release plan with build validation, automated tests, image scanning, signed artifacts, staging deployment, approval gates, canary rollout, health checks, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: Help migrate a Kubernetes team to GitOps.
output_examples.output: A GitOps adoption plan covering repository layout, environment overlays, sync policy, secret handling, promotion workflow, drift alerts, and operational runbooks.

output_examples.input: Improve rollback readiness for production deployments.
output_examples.output: A rollback checklist with trigger conditions, ownership, validation steps, monitoring signals, database compatibility checks, and post-incident follow-up items.

best_practices: Provide current tool choices, environment names, approval requirements, and release frequency before requesting a design.
Ask for rollback, observability, and incident response details with every production deployment plan.
Validate generated pipeline recommendations in staging before using them for production releases.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for production rollout steps without approvals, rollback criteria, and owner responsibilities.
Do not treat generated deployment plans as a substitute for compliance or security review.
Do not request tool-specific configuration without sharing platform constraints and secret handling requirements.

faq.question: What deployment platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Flux, Kubernetes, and related delivery tools.

faq.question: Can it create a complete CI/CD design?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline stages, gates, security checks, deployment strategy, monitoring, and rollback planning.

faq.question: Does it run deployment commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and plans. Users must review and execute changes through their approved systems.

faq.question: Can it help with GitOps adoption?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan repository structure, promotion workflows, configuration overlays, sync policies, and drift handling.

faq.question: How should I prepare a request?
faq.answer: Share your environments, delivery tools, compliance needs, service type, risk tolerance, and current release pain points.

faq.question: Is it useful for regulated environments?
faq.answer: Yes, but generated guidance must be reviewed against your internal controls and external compliance obligations.
